response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong open-source and craftsmanship track record, but the profile is a poor match for this role's mandatory requirements. C++ exposure is limited to roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2014–2015 (plus a university thesis project), far short of the required 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. There is no SQL Server or Oracle experience (only MySQL/MongoDB listed generically), no Windows-platform development focus, and no fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience — RIDE Capital was a Node/TypeScript/GraphQL retail investment product, not a capital-markets systems environment. The recent career trajectory (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, AI tooling) points away from the low-latency C++ banking stack this role requires.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering experience with strong testing/TDD, CI/CD, and low-latency systems work
Some fintech exposure at RIDE Capital and prior C/C++ work at National Instruments
Excellent demonstrated communication skills via conference talks, workshops, and courses
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, dated to 2014–2015, versus 5–10 years required
No fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain knowledge
No SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-platform development background
